youtube.summary: "I've yet to meet many people, many ordinary people or normal people, who know who their member of parliament even is, unless they are high profile." - Matt Robson, Auckland Barrister Matt Robson questions whether electorate MPs are still as important as they once were, arguing that many voters don't even know who represents their local area. If people don't know their electorate MP, does that weaken the case for keeping electorate seats, or show that MPs need to do a better job connecting with their communities? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/don-brash-matt-robson-former-reserve-bank-governor-auckland-barrister-election-uncertainty-new-zealands-future #RCRMedia

youtube.summary: "We don't want a repeat of it. It's really that simple, Simon." - Alia Bland, RCR Co-Founder Alia Bland recounts the devastating personal toll of the COVID years, including families still divided and New Zealanders struggling with the consequences of decisions made under the previous Labour government. Her warning centres on the lasting harm she says people continue to experience and her determination not to see those years repeated. With Labour seeking a return to government, what accountability should its leaders face for the decisions of 2020-2023, and what safeguards would prevent history repeating itself? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/the-fourth-estate-with-chantelle-baker-alia-bland-overhang-the-medias-great-left-lean #RCRMedia #TheFourthEstate

Edgeler makes an important distinction between a board's influence over party agreements and the actual voting powers of MPs. If TOP's boardroom becomes a battleground, will coalition negotiations need a mediator, a referee or a circus tent? 🎪 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/graeme-edgeler-constitutional-electoral-law-expert-tops-two-board-member-veto #RCRMedia

youtube.summary: "What we can't see is the electorates that National will win. And that is the thing you're not measuring by those polls." - Don Brash, Former Reserve Bank Governor National sits at 26.4% in the cited Freshwater Strategy poll, but Don Brash says that figure alone doesn't reveal the full MMP picture. He believes National could win significantly more electorate seats than its party vote would ordinarily justify. Are voters and commentators overlooking the electorate results when interpreting national party-vote polling? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/don-brash-matt-robson-former-reserve-bank-governor-auckland-barrister-election-uncertainty-new-zealands-future #RCRMedia

Is the greater economic risk undertaxing accumulated wealth, or creating incentives for investment to leave the country? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/don-brash-matt-robson-former-reserve-bank-governor-auckland-barrister-election-uncertainty-new-zealands-future

If a hospital could have a specialist for two and a half days a week, why risk losing them for all five? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/alex-price-act-candidate-for-mount-albert-cost-of-living-blamed-for-falling-birth-rate #RCRMedia

If TOP fails to cross the 5% threshold, will RNZ need a support group to cope with the disappointment? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/paul-henry-act-candidate-and-veteran-nz-broadcaster-government-debt-is-eating-into-new-zealanders-lives #RCRMedia

youtube.title: "On the right, you've got a whole bunch, the majority of party votes just going into the rubbish bin
youtube.summary: "On the right, you've got a whole bunch, the majority of party votes just going into the rubbish bin." - Dr Muriel Newman, Founder, NZ Centre for Political Research THE OVERHANG TRAP! Dr Muriel Newman warns that if National wins more electorate seats than its party vote entitles it to, additional National party votes could fail to deliver any extra MPs. That means votes intended to strengthen National may have no further impact on its seat count. With a potential overhang changing the usual MMP calculations, how many New Zealanders realise their party vote might deliver no additional seats for one party, while potentially making a difference to another in the same bloc? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/muriel-newman-nz-centre-for-political-research-founder-who-really-runs-new-zealand #RCRMedia
